description: This file defines the 'BuzzCommentSearchFilterParams' class which extends 'FilterParams' and encapsulates search filter parameters for buzz comments, specifically for filtering by share ID and setting default sorting.

classes.name: BuzzCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class used for specifying search filters for buzz comments, including sorting and share ID filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'comment.createdAtUtc'.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Getter method to retrieve the share ID filter value.

methods.name: setShareId
methods.description: Setter method to assign the share ID value used for filtering buzz comments.
